description: Mix, blend, lighten, darken, saturate, or desaturate colors. For mix/blend provide 2+ colors; for lighten/darken/saturate/desaturate provide 1 color and an amount.

colors.description: Array of colors in any supported format

operation.description: Operation: mix, blend, lighten, darken, saturate, desaturate

ratio.description: Blend ratio from 0 (first color) to 1 (second color). Default: 0.5.

weights.description: Optional weights for mixing (same length as colors). Default: equal weights.

name: color_mix
